messages:
Sam C.: Reminder — quick sync about adding a "budget-based downshift" policy to routing. Goal: automatically route low-tier/low-SLA traffic to cheaper model variants in soft bursts when token costs spike by region. Thinking this should be opt-in per-tenant and visible in Console.

Priya R.: +1. Important to show both cost saved and any quality regressions per prompt set. We need telemetry hooks: per-route token cost, regen rate, and a short eval delta tied to the tenant's golden prompts.

Jorge L.: prefer a probabilistic downshift rather than hard flip. e.g. sample 20% of requests to cheap variant and measure quality, then ramp if metrics ok. avoids sharp UX cliffs.

Mira V.: Console UX notes: add a "Cost Guards" panel on tenant config with: toggle (opt-in), slider for "max hourly token spend", a mode dropdown (probabilistic / hard / gradual), and a chart for "degradation events". Also show recent rollout decisions and allow manual rollback.

DevEx Bot: FYI design doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/routing/budget-downshift (draft). Also added a draft mock in Figma: figma.com/... (shared). 

Infra Bot: infra constraints: cheaper variants may be quantized on different GPU families; routing needs region-aware variant selection. Also need to ensure KV-cache compatibility — switching model ids must preserve applicable prefix caching or fall back to cold-start.

Jorge L.: +1 on KV-cache; maybe only allow downshift for stateless completions or chat with small context. Also we should limit max_tokens on the cheap variant to avoid cost inversion.

Sam C.: prototype policy sketch (for discussion):

```
{"policy":"budget_downshift_v1",
 "scope":"tenant",
 "conditions":{
   "tier": ["starter","growth"],
   "region": ["eu-west-1","ap-northeast-1"],
   "hourly_token_rate_pct": ">=120"
 },
 "action":{
   "variant":"redwood-small-quant",
   "mode":"probabilistic",
   "probability":0.25,
   "max_response_tokens":512
 }
}
```

Mira V.: UX question — do we surface the raw policy json or provide a guided form? I vote guided form with an "advanced" toggle.

Priya R.: telemetry: add an "eval-backstop" metric for each tenant that runs 1k sample prompts daily against baseline and cheap variant and reports BLEU/ROUGE-ish deltas + customer-visible error rate. Also add latency and token-per-request deltas.

Ops S.: ops concern — if many tenants opt-in, we could push load to GPU types with cheaper kernels and create capacity imbalances. Need cross-team quota shaping and a backpressure policy (reject or queue cheap-variant requests when that pool saturates).

Infra Bot: propose a fallback ladder: preferred cheap variant -> regional cheap pool -> global cheap pool -> if unavailable, fall back to baseline (if tier allows) else return 429 with clear error and "suggested action" message.

Sam C.: action items:
 - Jorge: prototype probabilistic sampler + experiment harness (owner: Jorge)
 - Priya: telemetry spec & eval-backstop (owner: Priya)
 - Mira: console mockups + guided form (owner: Mira)
 - Ops: propose quota shaping thresholds and backpressure behavior (owner: Ops S.)
 - Infra: mapping of variant->GPU family and KV-cache constraints (owner: Infra Bot)

Sam C.: scheduling a 30m sync Tuesday 10:30 PT to review prototypes. If you can't make it add notes in the doc. Thanks :thumbsup:
